html:
Quest Giver: The Wishing Well

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Toss a King's Coin down the well for good luck!

Quest Reward: None listed in the client files

Return to: The Wishing Well

Repeatable: Yes

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Toss a King's Coin down the well for good luck!

Offer:

The Wishing Well likes to eat coins!

Turn-in:

The King's Coin clanks as you toss it down the well.

Objectives:

  • King's Coin ×1

Client level range: 1–100
